task_summary: Replace overly generic guidance with a bounded close reading of existing authorized local text. Private source content, identities and individual assessments are excluded.
workflow_version: WORKFLOW_REVIEW.md and WORKFLOW_DATABASE.md verified in this round

acceptance: Recheck original exchanges and surrounding replies before evaluating interpretations.
Identify both supported observations and inference limits, with concrete communication improvements.
Respect the user-stated meaning and scope while avoiding unsupported factual or psychological claims.
completed: Coordinator reread relevant continuous passages from two existing snapshots.
Two native reviewers returned bounded independent reviews; their scopes were disclosed.
Checked speaker references, temporal context, reply targets and the distinction between partial agreement and whole-explanation confirmation.
Verified two public research abstracts using general queries without private content.
Prepared a response tied to specific exchanges rather than a generic advice template.

metrics.name: Independent reviewers
metrics.basis: Two actual read-only follow-up tasks returned; no recursive delegation.

metrics.name: User-requested response repair
metrics.basis: User explicitly reported that prior generic advice did not address the intended question.

metrics.name: Observed interval
metrics.basis: First captured local clock to report preparation; excludes initial commentary and subsequent archive.

metrics.name: Coordination wait
metrics.basis: Reading and review overlapped without isolated wait measurement.

metrics.name: Review and archive overhead
metrics.basis: Review interleaved with close reading; archival follows this cutoff.

observations: Prior guidance missed the requested level of specificity; rereading adjacent exchanges recovered both corroboration and corrections.
An independent reader flagged an ambiguous referent that could otherwise have been misattributed.
Agreement on a nearby statement does not validate every preceding inference.
One combined output exceeded its display budget; final cited passages were checked in smaller local reads.
No matched baseline supports a net efficiency or speedup claim.

recommendations.action: For interpretive follow-ups, first reconstruct the exact exchange, distinguish intention from content, and identify which proposition a reply actually confirms; preserve observed strengths alongside corrections.
recommendations.next_check: Next close-reading response should contain verified examples of both supported and unsupported interpretations and state the rereading scope.

evidence: Coordinator source checks and two received bounded read-only review responses.
Private repository visibility checked before archive.
limits: This round reread selected continuous exchanges, not the entire collection.
Media and private historical accounts were not independently verified.
Reader agreement is not independent evidence about hidden motives.
Archive readback will be recorded separately after upload.
